_rationale: Legacy monotonic MECHANICAL import floor for gates/design/asset-qc-gate.mjs. It rejects degenerate geometry and missing texture slots, but it is not a visual-quality verdict and cannot satisfy the Project Gorgon release floor. Final acceptance is governed by plans/visual-fidelity-release-contract.md and explicit human review.

building._note: Mechanical minimum only. It rejects a flat-box cottage but does not establish production visual fidelity, material richness, draw-call fitness, provenance, LOD coverage, composition, or reference quality.

provenance.measuredFrom: historical untracked assets/kit-building.glb (not valid current evidence)
provenance.evidenceStatus: invalidated; source asset is absent from the repository
ratchetTargets: requiresNormalMap: true remains a required ratchet — the #1 mechanical raise. The gate already enforces requiresNormalMap when true; flip it the moment a normal-mapped reference asset passes. This mechanical minimum is not dropped by the release-contract reframing: it may only be SUPERSEDED by a stronger requirement (e.g. verified PBR normal-detail evidence in the final material pipeline), never removed outright.
Replace the historical seed with a tracked, provenance-complete, optimized asset and measured QC evidence.
Add mesh/draw-call, texture-resolution, LOD, provenance, and stale-hash gates; raw triangle or vertex count is not a quality proxy.
Keep this mechanical floor orthogonal to the visual release contract and human reference review.
